Good morning Bill,

Not yet, and I'm sorry we didn't come back to you about it sooner. Order Shop···· is paid and still at our Brampton warehouse, and the Thor P2 stock it's waiting on hasn't been checked in there yet, so the October 29 date on your order has slipped. Nothing else is holding the box.

I've asked the team to confirm the new Brampton date, and a colleague is picking that up today so you get it in writing. You can follow the incoming shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Your tracking email goes out automatically the moment the label is made.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Bill,

You're welcome. Nothing is needed from you in the meantime. A colleague is confirming the new Brampton ship date today and you'll have it in writing, and the tracking email goes out on its own the moment the label is made.

If anything else comes up on the Thor P2 or your other units, just reply here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
